mapper.select: # 查询日期内新老访客占比 SELECT sum(new_user) as new_user, sum(old_user) as old_user FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(create_time)) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS old_user, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(create_time)) = 1 AND MAX(create_time) >= #{start} AND MAX(create_time) <= #{end} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_user FROM t_link_access_logs WHERE full_short_url = 'nurl.ink/2pRaH6' AND gid = 'VsyAaf' AND user IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user ) AS subquery; -- 再按新老访客分组统计数量
